name: Ulamog
description: Ulamog is one of the three Eldrazi titans, whose brood devours the life of Zendikar and who was worshipped as a god by some.

summary.text: Ulamog is one of the three Eldrazi titans, whose brood devours the life of Zendikar and who was worshipped as a god by some.

bio.text: Ulamog returned and devastated Nissa's Joraga tribe, and he later arrived on Zendikar alongside Kozilek and Emrakul, who were petrified over Akoum and sealed away.
When he escaped his prison he destroyed Bala Ged first.
Ugin told Jace that Ulamog could not be killed and proposed imprisoning the Eldrazi again, while Jace learned he was heading for Sea Gate.
Gideon, Jace and Nissa trapped Ulamog in a ring of hedrons at Sea Gate.
Ob Nixilis knocked a hedron out of alignment, freeing him and collapsing the network, and then called Kozilek from beneath Zendikar.
Kozilek freed his brother Ulamog, and the two titans wandered the land, with Sea Gate toppled.
Finally, Chandra baited Ulamog while Nissa wove Zendikar's leylines into a glyph that bound the titans, and Chandra's fire along the leylines destroyed them.

status.text: He is dead, destroyed with Kozilek near Sea Gate by the Gatewatch's founders, though later pages still recall him as a past threat.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes pinned under a fallen tree after the Eldrazi swarm and Ulamog's return devastate her Joraga tribe.
timeline.quote: Eldrazi had swarmed the Joraga. There had been a great blast of energy. Ulamog had returned.

timeline.summary: Too drained to planeswalk, Nissa lies helpless as Ulamog's shadow passes over her, devouring the life from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Planeswalking was out of the question.

timeline.summary: A human man pulls Nissa from under the tree and heals her as Ulamog closes in; she blesses him and passes out.
timeline.quote: Stay alive. We'll get you out of here.

timeline.summary: From their ropes the party sees a Pathrazer spawn of Ulamog emerge below to attack travelers, and Sha'heel drops toward it.
timeline.quote: Nissa looked over her shoulder to see Sha'heel pull out a knife and cut his anchor lines with one smooth motion.

timeline.summary: An enormous Eldrazi rises beyond the valley and the brood surges toward the camp.
timeline.quote: Then a figure, impossibly large, rose up behind the hills on the far side of the valley.

timeline.summary: The plane begins to come apart as a crack in the world opens and the refugees are swept away.
timeline.quote: The plane was coming apart.

timeline.summary: The three titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul arrive on Zendikar, and Ugin and Sorin fight their brood as the titans march toward the hedron nexus.
timeline.quote: Ugin breathed his ghostfire, searing the Eldrazi brood with invisible flame.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi stand petrified over Akoum and the chamber is sealed with a lock that requires three Planeswalkers to open.
timeline.quote: Looming above the highlands of Akoum, the three Eldrazi stood petrified, surrounded by a web of floating hedrons.

timeline.summary: Nahiri discovers a bloodstained altar and a statue of Ulamog, and realizes the vampires' sacrifices disrupted the hedron network.
timeline.quote: their rites had successfully disrupted the hedron network enough for the Eldrazi broods to spill forth.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya watch from a ridge over the Vastwood Forest, looking at the white corruption left by Ulamog's brood.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi drained the life and essence from all the living things they encountered.

timeline.summary: Ayli presents Jace and Jori as offerings to Ulamog, whom the Eternal Pilgrims worship.
timeline.quote: "Welcome, offerings, to the sanctuary," said Ayli

timeline.summary: Jace realizes Ulamog is drawn to concentrations of population and that Sea Gate and other refuges will become tombs.
timeline.quote: And those trusted landmarks would become—tombs.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Jori someone must warn Gideon that Ulamog is heading for Sea Gate while he goes on to the Eye alone.
timeline.quote: "Go back and warn them. I'm going to the Eye."

timeline.summary: Drana bores into the sire's heart and drinks its energy, recovering memories of her origin as a creature of Ulamog.
timeline.quote: I was no longer an extension of it, of the consuming force named Ulamog.

timeline.summary: Kiora announces she will go to Sea Gate to stop Ulamog, and Yenai says his group will flee to Murasa.
timeline.quote: "Depends," said Kiora. "I'm going to Sea Gate."

timeline.summary: Jace tells Ugin that Ulamog is headed for Sea Gate, and Ugin shows he does not know the city, having been away for ages.
timeline.quote: I was detained. Sea Gate?

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Jace that Ulamog cannot be killed and proposes imprisoning the Eldrazi again with the help of his allies.
timeline.quote: You cannot kill Ulamog,

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi titans dwell in the Blind Eternities and what Jace sees is a projection, so killing them would only free them.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi titans do not dwell in physical space,

timeline.summary: Ugin orders Jace to dissuade his friends from attacking Ulamog and to stop them if necessary, so Ulamog is not driven from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You must dissuade your friends from attacking Ulamog directly

timeline.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Kiora gather in the lighthouse, and Jori En bursts in to warn that Ulamog is coming.
timeline.quote: "Ulamog is coming!"

timeline.summary: Jori En bursts in with news that Ulamog is coming and that Jace delayed her return so she could warn them.
timeline.quote: Ulamog is coming!

timeline.summary: At dawn Seble sees Ulamog approaching, and Nissa restrains the urge to attack it alone.
timeline.quote: And that's when she saw the titan.

timeline.summary: Gideon stands alone before Ulamog while Jace rehearses the trap with illusions, and Ulamog lurches into the ring.
timeline.quote: as Ulamog lurched through.

timeline.summary: Gideon, nearly overwhelmed by Ulamog, holds out until a blue flash lifts the pressure and the titan is pulled into the glowing prison.
timeline.quote: Ulamog had been pulled within the bounds of the hedron prison

timeline.summary: At Sea Gate he sees Ulamog trapped in an enormous hedron network.
timeline.quote: Armies clashing, spawn and Zendikari slaughtered by the thousands, and rising above it all, Ulamog. Trapped.

timeline.summary: He knocks a structural hedron out of alignment, freeing Ulamog and collapsing the network, and Nissa sees him.
timeline.quote: A snap of my fingers, and one of the structural hedrons fell out of alignment.

timeline.summary: He unleashes a bolt of annihilation on the armies, cutting off their retreat and forcing them toward Ulamog.
timeline.quote: I let loose an enormous bolt of withering annihilation into the armies below

timeline.summary: As she leaves, Chandra sees Ulamog advancing on Sea Gate and realizes this is what she helped unleash.
timeline.quote: This was what she had helped unleash.

timeline.summary: Chandra arrives at Sea Gate and finds Ulamog trapped in the hedron ring while Zendikari cheer.
timeline.quote: Ulamog was trapped.

timeline.summary: A winged demon draws power from the hedron prison, causing the hedrons to fall and freeing Ulamog.
timeline.quote: The circle was breaking.

timeline.summary: Chandra fails to hurt the demon or the titan, and a second Eldrazi titan rises from the ground.
timeline.quote: A second Eldrazi titan had entered the battle.

timeline.summary: Jori En returns with the news that Ulamog is headed toward Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi titan Ulamog himself was headed towards Sea Gate.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Jace and Nissa trap Ulamog in a ring of hedrons at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Gideon lured the titan into the center of the ring while the other two activated the network, imprisoning Ulamog.

timeline.summary: Gideon attacks the trapped Ulamog, but Ob Nixilis calls Kozilek from beneath Zendikar, leaving two titans rampaging.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis had called Kozilek, one of the other Eldrazi titans, from beneath Zendikar's surface.

timeline.summary: Riding Lorthos, Kiora and the tricksters converge on Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Slowly but inexorably, Lorthos and Ula converged on Sea Gate.

timeline.summary: Kiora sees Ulamog trapped in the hedron ring, then the hedrons fall and he is freed.
timeline.quote: Whatever the cause, the effect was clear: Ula was free of his prison.

timeline.summary: Nissa heaves the last hedron into place, trapping Ulamog, and prepares to destroy him while Jace outlines a plan.
timeline.quote: Nissa had heaved the last hedron into place , trapping Ulamog, the monster that had ravaged her world.

timeline.summary: Nissa tries to complete the broken circle with her own body but is struck down by Ulamog's tentacle.
timeline.quote: Nissa only saw the thick, pink tentacle after it had struck her.

timeline.summary: The rest of the ring collapses and Ulamog, free again, moves toward Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Ulamog, free of his bonds, was moving toward Sea Gate once more.

timeline.summary: Kozilek rises, Ulamog is freed, and Tazri rallies her soldiers away from the collapsing Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Tazri rallied her soldiers away from the collapsing Sea Gate

timeline.summary: Chandra searches the battlefield for Gideon and Jace while two titans wander the land and a swarm approaches.
timeline.quote: Too many to take on by herself.

timeline.summary: Jori breaks the surface and sees Sea Gate toppled and eroded by Kozilek's blight, remembering that Ulamog was freed and Kozilek rose.
timeline.quote: The hedron network had failed. Ulamog was free.

timeline.summary: From the mountains Gideon sees the ruin of Sea Gate and the two titans creeping across the land, and realizes his army is gone.
timeline.quote: His army was gone.

timeline.summary: Chandra leads the group that baits Ulamog, while Gideon leads the other bait army toward Kozilek, toward Jace and Nissa waiting in the titans' path.
timeline.quote: The plan involved being as noticeably, tantalizingly alive as possible

timeline.summary: Nissa lights with magic and weaves Zendikar's leylines into a tripartite glyph that lashes around the titans.
timeline.quote: A tripartite glyph a hundred feet wide appeared on the floor of the valley in fierce green fire.

timeline.summary: The leylines go taut and hold the titans, who shriek and shake the earth, but the spell absorbs all of Zendikar's mana.
timeline.quote: But then the leylines snapped taut.

timeline.summary: The titans distort, the sky becomes the titans, and it begins raining Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: And then it began raining Eldrazi.

timeline.summary: Cracks spread through the titans as the glyph erodes them, but Zendikar breaks faster and floating landmasses begin to fall.
timeline.quote: The titans, finally, were beginning to break.

timeline.summary: Nissa touches Chandra's shoulder, sending the mana of all Zendikar through her, and Chandra ignites the leylines.
timeline.quote: The leylines themselves caught fire

timeline.summary: The titans are destroyed in a blinding blast, and Chandra collapses.
timeline.quote: The world flashed with a roar of apocalyptic orange, then went blinding white.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees Ulamog on the horizon.
timeline.quote: The Devourer. The one Ugin called Ulamog .

timeline.summary: Chandra snaps at Nissa asking if she even has a mother, and Nissa reveals that Ulamog destroyed her people's home of Bala Ged.
timeline.quote: it was the first place he destroyed

timeline.summary: Akiri leaves her kor band after an Eldrazi attack kills her comrades.
timeline.quote: she struck out on her own when an Eldrazi attack killed her comrades

timeline.summary: Camped on the gorge rim, Akiri reflects on the Eldrazi, Ulamog and the reminders Zareth's return brings.
timeline.quote: Akiri recalled the chill in Sea Gate under Ulamog

timeline.summary: With the help of the Gatewatch's four founders, the titans Ulamog and Kozilek are destroyed near Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the titans Ulamog and Kozilek were destroyed near the city of Sea Gate.

relations.note: The Pathrazer is a spawn of the titan Ulamog.
relations.quote: a Pathrazer—a spawn of the titan Ulamog

relations.note: One of the three true Eldrazi titans.
relations.quote: The one Sorin and Nahiri had seen before, the enormous thing that Ugin called Ulamog, was in fact the smallest of the three.

relations.note: They worship Ulamog as a god.
relations.quote: Whether Ulamog heard the vampires' prayers or not

relations.note: Worship the titan as the god Mangeni, Ula.
relations.quote: The presence of the god Mangeni, whose second name is Ula

relations.note: She was made in the shadow of her makers and recalls being its extension.
relations.quote: I was no longer an extension of it, of the consuming force named Ulamog.

relations.note: Zendikar's merfolk gods were unmasked as the titans.
relations.quote: since unmasked as the Eldrazi titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul.

relations.note: Kiora is determined to slay Ulamog.
Ulamog is trapped within the ring when Ob Nixilis arrives.
She helped unleash the Eldrazi and tries to fight them.
relations.quote: This—Ulamog— this was what the true battle was about.

relations.note: Kiora sets out to kill the titan she thinks of as Ula.
relations.quote: At last, she would punish Ula for what he had done to her people and her world
He freed his brother, and now they are on the loose.

relations.note: Chandra's fire along the leylines destroys the titans.
relations.quote: Flames spiraled from Chandra into the streams of mana and branched out across the sky

relations.note: Ulamog destroyed Bala Ged first when he escaped his prison.
relations.quote: it was the first place he destroyed

relations.note: She safeguards travelers from the titan.
relations.quote: Now she uses her line-slinging expertise to safeguard travelers from Ulamog.

relations.note: Ulamog loomed over Sea Gate during the Battle.
relations.quote: in the shadow of the beast free of its ancient chains

relations.note: Helped destroy the titans near Sea Gate.
relations.quote: the titans Ulamog and Kozilek were destroyed near the city of Sea Gate.
